civmodern.screen.map.snitchopacity.toolt:
Opacity of the snitch layer, on the map and minimap, in the translucent mode.
The layer fades as a whole, so overlapping snitches do not pile up into a solid blot.
Cycle solid, translucent and hidden with the snitch button on the map, or the minimap snitch key (J by default).
civmodern.screen.sizepreview.hint: Scroll to zoom the map. Press %s or use - / + to zoom the minimap.
civmodern.screen.waypointpreview.title: Waypoint size preview
civmodern.screen.waypointpreview.mapbase:
The map zoom (blocks per pixel) up to which waypoint icons are drawn at full size.
Zoom out past it and they start shrinking.
The map ranges from 1/32 (closest) to your max zoom.
civmodern.screen.waypointpreview.maplogb:
How quickly icons shrink once zoomed out past the base zoom.
Each time the zoom multiplies by this number, icons drop another step: 1/2, 1/3, 1/4 of full size.
Lower shrinks faster; higher keeps icons large for longer.
civmodern.screen.waypointpreview.minimap:
The minimap zoom (blocks per pixel) up to which icons are drawn at full size.
Zoom out past it and they start shrinking.
The minimap ranges from 1/2 (closest) to 16.

civmodern.screen.nodes.title: Civ Modern Config (Node Overlay)
civmodern.screen.nodes.query.tooltip: Keep asking the server for node data. Turning this off freezes the overlay on what is already cached; it does not hide it. Use the button on the map to hide the layer.
civmodern.screen.nodes.borders.tooltip: Outline the seams between nodes, and between territory and open ground, when zoomed in
civmodern.screen.nodes.grid.tooltip: Dash a slim line around every chunk inside a node, so single chunks can be counted off without mistaking one for the edge of the node
civmodern.screen.nodes.unclaimed.tooltip: Paint nodes nobody has claimed, in grey. Turning this off leaves them as bare map, so only territory somebody holds is coloured in.
civmodern.screen.nodes.opacity.tooltip: Fill opacity in the solid overlay mode. Borders and markers stay at full strength.
civmodern.screen.nodes.translucentopacit: Opacity of the whole layer, lines included, in the translucent overlay mode.
